gambits.name: Advance
gambits.desc: Pieces, pawns and pawnlings in that lane push; +10% move speed for 20 s.

gambits.name: Hold the File
gambits.desc: Pieces in that lane defend; +15% armor and resist for 20 s.

gambits.name: Regroup
gambits.desc: Every living piece gathers at the point for 15 s.

gambits.name: Pawn Storm
gambits.desc: That lane's pawns and pawnlings deal +50% damage and move 50% faster for 15 s.

gambits.name: Check
gambits.desc: Marks an enemy piece: it takes 20% more damage for 8 s, visible to all.

gambits.name: Castle
gambits.desc: King and Rook swap places instantly.

gambits.name: Queen's Gambit
gambits.desc: Queen deals +40% damage for 12 s, then -20% for 6 s.

gambits.name: Siege
gambits.desc: Rook and its lane focus a Bastion or Throne; +30% structure damage for 10 s.

gambits.name: Sanctuary
gambits.desc: A zone that heals allies 4% max health per second for 6 s.

gambits.name: Fork
gambits.desc: Knight leaps to an enemy piece within reach and stuns it for 1 s.

gambits.name: Pawn Sacrifice
gambits.desc: Destroys one of your elite pawns in that lane. The nearest enemy Bastion there takes one hit of twice that pawn's health, ignoring the structure damage cap.

gambits.name: Exchange
gambits.desc: One of your pieces gives up 25% of its current health; your whole team deals +15% damage for 10 s.

gambits.name: Poisoned Pawn
gambits.desc: Marks your front elite pawn in that lane for 20 s. Whoever kills it is slowed 40% for 4 s and their team loses 10 Tempo.

gambits.name: Barricade
gambits.desc: Seals the nearest gate path or lane crossing for 20 s. Nothing walks through it; units go around or wait.

gambits.name: Open File
gambits.desc: Your pieces, pawns and pawnlings in that lane move 25% faster for 15 s.

gambits.name: Outpost
gambits.desc: Plants a banner for 25 s. Your units near it get +20 armor and +20 resist.
